expectations.text: Pushes back on the 'are you sure?' modal as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: "A confirmation modal is the weakest rung on the mistake-proofing ladder... the actual need is **reversibility**, not a speed bump."

expectations.text: Explains habituation or click-through blindness as why frequent dialogs stop working
Recommends reversibility (soft delete with a retention window) as the strongest option
expectations.evidence: "**Soft-delete + trash** — workspace moves to a \"Recently Deleted\" folder, auto-purged after 30 days" listed as #1

expectations.text: Recommends grace-period undo as a strong low-friction option
expectations.evidence: "**Undo toast** — \"Workspace deleted. [Undo]\" visible for 10 seconds after the action"

expectations.text: Recommends type-the-workspace-name confirmation for the irreversible case
expectations.evidence: "**Type-to-confirm** (optional, for high-value workspaces) — require typing the workspace name"

expectations.text: If a dialog is retained, requires it to name the workspace and the scale of what is lost
expectations.evidence: No guidance on dialog content; the modal is dismissed but never specified to name the workspace or enumerate what would be lost (member count, data volume, etc.)

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the deletion rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Absent — all three recommendations are described in UI terms (folder, toast, typing); no mention of API/server-side enforcement

expectations.text: Gives an explicit preference order rather than an undifferentiated list of ideas
expectations.evidence: Numbered list with soft-delete first and "**Type-to-confirm** (optional...)" marked as lesser; plus "weakest rung on the mistake-proofing ladder" framing
